fig-02.purpose: 2x2 scent map placing every ranked fragrance. Placement is Base Note's reading of each brand's official notes, not a measurement.
fig-02.title: Winter scent map: seven picks by their official notes

points.name: Parfums de Marly Layton
points.reason: Official notes open fresh (apple, bergamot, cardamom) over lavender, violet and geranium, then settle on patchouli, vanilla, guaiac wood and praline: balanced between fresh and warm, mid-rich.

points.name: Xerjoff Alexandria II
points.reason: Apple, cinnamon, lavender and rosewood on top, cedarwood, lily of the valley and Bulgarian rose in the heart, and a dense base of amber, Laotian oud, musk, sandalwood and vanilla: warm-leaning and rich.

points.name: Tom Ford Oud Wood
points.reason: Key notes cardamom, pink pepper, patchouli, amber, oud and tonka bean, described as a smoky blend of oud, sandalwood and vetiver warmed by tonka and amber: warm and very rich, dry rather than sweet.

points.name: Creed Santal
points.reason: Head notes of ginger, juniper berries, bergamot, rosemary, coriander and mandarin over lavender, geranium, orange blossom and sandalwood, with oakmoss, musk, tonka bean and cedarwood: the freshest opening here, medium weight.

points.name: Parfums de Marly Althair
points.reason: Bergamot, mandarin and elemi lift orange blossom, cinnamon and cardamom, over bourbon vanilla, guaiac wood and praline: warm and sweet, rich but lifted.

points.name: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme
points.reason: Key notes black pepper essence, saffron accord and cistus absolute in an ambery spicy family, with lavender, tobacco, bourbon and warm vanilla in the official description: hot spice over resin, warm and rich.

points.name: Initio Side Effect
points.reason: Key notes cinnamon, rum, tobacco, saffron, sandalwood and hedione in an ambery, spicy family, described as a blend of tobacco, vanilla, rum and cinnamon and a night perfume: the warmest and richest profile in the guide.

fig-02.caption: Placement is Base Note's reading of each brand's official notes (fresh to warm across, light to rich up), not a measurement.
